_comment: Fragment za Google Antigravity (agy). Spaja se u ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json pod ključ 'mcpServers', ili se registruje komandom: agy mcp add --env OBSIDIAN_VAULT=<VAULT> --env OBSIDIAN_AGENT=agy --env OBSIDIAN_ROLE=researcher obsidian node <VAULT>/tools/mcp/obsidian-mcp.mjs Upis zahteva OBSIDIAN_TASK (zadatak pod zakupom); OBSIDIAN_TASK_ROOT pokazuje na kontrolni koren (main).
